_comment: E02-T10: single declared source for the per-package quality-gate thresholds that CONSTITUTION.md §9 (#3, #4, #5, #15) requires. Values here MUST match the thresholds actually enforced in each package's own config (vitest coverage.thresholds, services/api/pyproject.toml --cov-fail-under, apps/web's size-limit budget) -- this file is a mirror for the drift/threshold-guard tooling (tools/ci/quality_gates.py), not a second place that configures anything. C-9.4: these are floors and may only be RAISED without an amendment; lowering a value needs an "amendment" key on that entry naming the CONSTITUTION.md amendment that authorised it.
